subject: Re: GPNR kickoff — generalizable view synthesis
body:
Hi Lucia,

Staffing: Csilla 60% (research lead), Milan 50% (training and infra), Carmen 40% (eval).

Compute: 64 A100s on titan best-effort for repro.

Data plan: the IBRNet scene collections and our internal catalog captures need to be in Corpus before the v2 migration freeze. The freeze is 2026-06-26, so I am scheduling final ingestion for the week of Jun 15 with Carmen owning validation — if we miss it we are stuck until the v2 migration completes.

Infra flag: the release pins jax[cuda110]==0.2.19, which predates our cluster's CUDA 12 drivers; Milan is rebuilding against a current JAX before repro starts, so add a few days of risk to the Mar 27 date.

Alina
